question: How far does the Lord's manifestation in wheel-forms extend?
premises: The Lord's forms are not limited to small numerical configurations.
They can extend to a thousand-spoked or even countless-spoked wheel.
The universal wheel is the field of this manifestation.
inference: Therefore the Great Lord unfolds as the power of the universe in wheels of any magnitude.
plain_english: Thus, in the universal wheel, whether it has a thousand spokes or even countless spokes, the Lord Maheśāna unfolds as the power of the whole universe.
